title: Anchors
coreMove: strip out the first number in the room before you make your own estimate
sourcePressure: shows that irrelevant starting points pull estimates and negotiations toward themselves
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: limiting anchoring to price negotiation rather than any starting value that pulls judgment
